rawAnswers.prompt: How much does a dental clinic cost in Hyderabad and which one is worth it
rawAnswers.text:
If you mean **the cost of dental treatment** (not opening a clinic), private-clinic prices in Hyderabad are roughly:

| Treatment | Approx. cost |
|---|---:|
| Consultation/check-up | ₹200–₹800 |
| Cleaning/scaling | ₹500–₹3,000 |
| Tooth-coloured filling | ₹800–₹3,500 |
| Root canal | ₹2,000–₹8,000, usually **plus a crown** if needed |
| Crown | ₹4,000–₹15,500 |
| Single implant | ₹19,000–₹58,000 |

These are estimates; the dentist, tooth, materials and scans can change the quote. ([teeth.in](https://teeth.in/dentists/hyderabad/?utm_source=openai))

**Which is worth it?**  
- **For the lowest-cost option:** Government Dental College & Hospital is listed as a subsidised option, though waits may be longer. ([teeth.in](https://teeth.in/dentists/hyderabad/?utm_source=openai))  
- **For a private clinic with prices published upfront:** Smilebook Dental in Bachupally / Smiles by Sneha in Gachibowli publishes a price list. That makes it easier to budget, but it isn’t an independent quality rating. ([smilebookdental.in](https://smilebookdental.in/dental-treatment-price-list-in-hyderabad/?utm_source=openai))

For a root canal, implant, braces or other costly work, get an **itemised written quote** and consider a second opinion. Ask whether the quote includes X-rays, the crown/implant parts, follow-ups and any extra procedures.

Tell me your **area in Hyderabad and the treatment you need**, and I can narrow this down. If you meant the cost of **setting up or buying** a dental clinic, say so—that’s a different estimate.
